If you want? Though don't you have to figure out why it hangs?

I believe the fix was to hide docker sandbox behind a flag (https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/c909639035b7e064bfeda48887eb7783f20843c3)

It'll be taken care of by @philwo when he's back at work.
